content:
name: Publish Package

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: write

# Releases are cut with `nr release` (bumpp --pr), which opens a `release/*`
# pull request. Merging that PR tags the merge commit and publishes from here.
on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - closed
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  publish-npm:
    # Only merged `release/*` pull requests that originate from this repository.
    # The same-repo check is essential: a fork can name its branch `release/*`
    # too, and this job runs with publishing credentials.
    if: >-
      github.event.pull_request.merged == true &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/')

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          # The merge commit is what carries the bumped version
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merge_commit_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@0977fd99725f1db4007ccb2928dbb4e90d06cc86 # v6.0.10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Read version
        id: version
        run: echo "version=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" >>
          "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Create tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merge_commit_sha }}
        run: |
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" \
            -f ref="refs/tags/v$VERSION" \
            -f sha="$SHA"
          # Mirror it locally, changelogithub resolves the release from git tags
          git tag "v$VERSION"

      - run: npm i -g npm@latest

      - run: pnpm install

      - run: npx changelogithub --no-group
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN}}

      - run: pnpm run update:full

      - run: pnpm run publish:ci
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
